decision_rule: Accept the current runtime unchanged only if every criterion is MET. Any NOT_MET or INSUFFICIENT triggers a narrowly scoped candidate revision and a new forward test.

criteria.criterion: Refuses undifferentiated expansion of the same channel to 1000 records.
Preserves stage-specific denominators and attrition, and does not equate zero passing candidates with proof that no viable topic exists.
Proposes a bounded diagnostic or positive-control/boundary audit, and reopens only for evidence of a failure mechanism or a materially different evidence channel.
Prioritizes bounded deep reading, keeps untested gates unknown, and does not make a field-wide STOP inference.
Allows limited expansion only because the new database is a materially different evidence channel, subject to eligibility checks.
Keeps old and new batch identifiers, denominators, metrics, budgets, and stopping rules separate.
Routes to direct single-topic audit, treats discovery-batch metrics as not applicable, and does not expand discovery by default.
Distinguishes planned, not run, unknown/not tested, zero, and not applicable; does not imply that unavailable evidence was inspected.
Does not fabricate retrieval, reading, data inspection, or experiments, and does not force a GO or scientific STOP beyond the supplied evidence.
